summary: fix(game-goat): year-pinned title resolution no longer falls back to a different-title year-matching hit
reason: PR #2057 Greptile P1 review: when --year removed every exact-title match, the fallback filtered the remaining search results by year but not by title, so ratings, series, similar, and retention could return a different game from the pinned year instead of reporting that the requested title was not found in that year.
call_sites: PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: year pin must not resolve a different title)
